cards.explanation: The answer is that she has just died. The man says, “My daughter has just died…” and then he keeps going: “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.” He doesn't stop at the bad news, friends. I think that takes more nerve than most of us have on a good day.

The answer is True! The synagogue leader says, “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.” His daughter has just died, and he still says WILL live. I'd have been standing there with my mustache in a knot, and this man is giving Jesus directions, friends.
The answer is False. The text says, “So Jesus got up and went with him, along with His disciples.” A man kneels and asks, and Jesus gets up and goes, friends.

The answer is the fringe of His cloak. The woman comes up behind Him and touches “…the fringe of His cloak.” Behind Him, just the edge. Bless her, friends, I would have tripped and knocked over a whole bakery table.
The answer is healed! The woman says to herself, “If only I touch His cloak, I will be healed.” Twelve years of bleeding, and her whole plan fits in one sentence. Short plan, big faith, friends.

The answer is faith. Jesus says, “Take courage, daughter…” and then, “your faith has healed you.” The text says she was healed from that very hour. Not next week, friends, not after a follow-up visit.

The answer is that she is not dead but asleep. Jesus says, “The girl is not dead, but asleep.” He says it to the flute players and the noisy crowd. And remember, friends, her father had said she'd just died. Jesus is about to show what He meant.

The answer is laughed. Jesus tells the crowd to go away, and then He says, “The girl is not dead, but asleep.” Right after that, the text says, “And they laughed at Him.” That's how the crowd answers what He says about the girl, friends. Their answer is laughter.

The answer is that He takes her by the hand. Jesus “…went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.” Remember, friends, her father said, “…place Your hand on her…” Jesus takes her hand, and she gets up. This happens after the crowd had been put outside.
The answer is False. The text says, “And the news about this spread throughout that region.” It didn't stay in the house, friends. It went out through the whole region.
